_comment: Demo seed data. The performer and licensee are fictional on purpose: the repo and demo video are public, so we must not publish authorization verdicts about real people. Findings below are illustrative shapes, not real URLs.

performers.name: Mira Vance
performers.notes: Fictional performer used for demo. Represented by the Ardent Talent Group (also fictional).

consents.compensation_trigger: Per-title fee on any synthetic voice line retained in final delivery.

clause_citations.quote: Producer may generate synthetic voice performances of the Artist solely for the Picture, in the United States and Canada.
No right is granted to generate or exploit a synthetic visual likeness of the Artist.

findings.evidence_quote: Instant AI voice model of Mira Vance - unlimited commercial use, $19/mo.
findings.reasoning: Commercial synthetic voice offering by a third party. No consent grants voice_synth rights to any licensee other than Halcyon Pictures.

findings.evidence_quote: Halcyon Pictures confirmed synthetic voice pickups were used for two lines in the North American cut.
findings.reasoning: Licensee matches cons_halcyon_2026; use is voice_synth within US/CA and inside the validity window.

findings.evidence_quote: Voz de IA da Mira Vance para seu comercial - entrega em 24h, pagamento em BRL.
findings.reasoning: Territory-scoped: the only voice_synth grant is limited to US/CA. Listing prices in BRL and targets Brazil, outside every granted territory. Found only on the pt-BR sweep.
Reverse-image hit with no textual claim of synthesis and no commercial signal. Below confidence threshold - routed to human review rather than guessed.

assets.reasoning: Vendor invoice declares AI voice replacement. Covered by cons_halcyon_2026 for US/CA delivery.
Synthetic visual likeness. cons_halcyon_2026 explicitly withholds visual likeness rights (p.5). Cannot deliver.
No provenance metadata and no vendor paperwork on file. Default is unverified - we prove coverage, we do not assume it.
